meta.title: Multi-deck Matron route inventory
meta.method: Source reading at the pinned commit. Rung heights and counts are computed by replaying each builder's float32 loop; no runtime probe was built. Capsule sweeps, machine loads, cable instantiation and reverse machine availability are UNVERIFIED.

status_values.candidate: geometry admits a 0.30 m / 2.1 m capsule using only walk, step, narrow-board, ladder, top-out mantle, top-entry descent or a machine ride the direction is authored for
status_values.blocked: a concrete reason prevents use (see blocker)
status_values.UNVERIFIED: facts needed to decide were not established
